title: XGBoost model estimates psychological-distress risk in patients with lung cancer
summary: The preprint reports an XGBoost calculator for psychological distress among 342 patients with lung cancer, evaluated with cross-validation and a test set. This is a risk-prediction result, not evidence that the calculator improves patient outcomes.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Development used data from 342 lung-cancer patients and reported cross-validated and test-set performance.
evidence.unknown: Preprint and sample-limited model evaluation; external prospective validation and effects on care were not established.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
